description:
A GNOME Shell extension that displays real-time blood glucose levels in the top panel. Supports LibreView (FreeStyle Libre), Dexcom Share, and Nightscout as data sources. Features customizable urgent high/low thresholds, color schemes, trend arrows, delta values, and comprehensive glucose monitoring options. Optional feature to upload LibreView data to Dexcom Share.

This extension is not affiliated, funded, or in any way associated with FreeStyle Libre, Abbott, Dexcom, or any CGM manufacturer.
name: Libre3View Blood Glucose Monitor
